description_en: This operation queries the precheck progress for a backup plan or a restore job
description_zh: 该接口用于查看备份计划预检查进度和恢复任务预检查进度
name: DescribePreCheckProgressList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan.

Specify either BackupPlanId or RestoreTaskId
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID。

请填入BackupPlanId或RestoreTaskId
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the restore job
parameters.name: restore_task_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
parameters.name: client_token
